title: Predicting, Evaluating, and Explaining Top Misinformation Spreaders via Archetypal User Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2608.16323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The spread of misinformation on social networks poses a significant challenge to online communities and society at large. Not all users contribute equally to this phenomenon: a small number of highly effective individuals can exert outsized influence, amplifying false narratives and contributing to significant societal harm. This paper seeks to mitigate the spread of misinformation by enabling proactive interventions, identifying and ranking users according to key behavioral indicators associated with harmful content dissemination. We examine three user archetypes -- amplifiers, super-spreaders, and coordinated accounts -- each characterized by distinct behavioral patterns in the dissemination of misinformation. translated_title: 通过原型用户行为预测、评估和解释顶级虚假信息传播者
translated_abstract: 社交网络上虚假信息的传播对在线社区和整个社会构成了重大挑战。并非所有用户对此现象贡献相同：少数极具影响力的个体可能产生不成比例的影响，放大虚假叙事并导致重大社会危害。本文旨在通过实现主动干预、根据与有害内容传播相关的关键行为指标识别和排序用户，来减轻虚假信息的传播。我们研究了三种用户原型——放大器、超级传播者和协调账户——每种原型在虚假信息传播中表现出不同的行为模式。这些原型并非相互排斥，个体用户可能表现出多种原型的特征。我们开发并评估了多种用户排名模型，每种模型针对特定原型，并发现超级传播者（此处原文截断，推测为“超级传播者模型在预测顶级传播者方面表现最佳”）。
tldr: 本文通过分析放大器、超级传播者和协调账户三种用户行为原型，开发了针对性的排名模型，以预测和评估虚假信息传播中的关键影响者，从而实现主动干预。
en_tdlr: This paper develops archetype-specific ranking models based on amplifier, super-spreader, and coordinated account behaviors to predict and evaluate key misinformation spreaders, enabling proactive intervention.
